_comment: MIS project-info lookup API, added 2026-08-12. The key is NOT stored here -- set MIS_API_KEY in your .env file (see .env.example); sent as an 'x-api-key' header (changed 2026-08-12 -- was a Bearer JWT before that). This file only holds non-secret settings. Per explicit instruction, the key is refreshed by hand: update MIS_API_KEY in .env and restart the server whenever it changes/rotates -- no auto-refresh is built.
